findings.summary: The record identity does not explicitly capture the rules revision and validated research-ledger revision required by the evaluator entry gate.
findings.evidence: Section 1 records the Domain version plus workflow and evaluator revisions, while the stabilized evaluator requires versions of DOMAIN.md, rules/BASE.md, workflows/WORKFLOW.md, and the validated research ledger. Section 4 records individual ledger source IDs and retrieval context, but no explicit immutable identity or revision for rules/BASE.md or the ledger as a whole. Add dedicated rules and research-ledger revision fields so evidence consumers need not infer those bindings.
